svg.title: The seven-piece kit
svg.desc: Animated layout of the seven-piece kit as the app draws it, beside the waveform of each piece's recorded acoustic sample; a struck pad flashes and a playhead runs over its waveform.
svg.text: THE SEVEN-PIECE KIT · ACOUSTIC SAMPLES · MIRRORED DISPLAY
the kit as the app draws it (configs/demo.fullkit.candidate.yaml)
Samples: “The Salamander Drumkit” by Alexander Holm, CC BY-SA 3.0 (hard layer, take 1 shown). Tom 2 is the rack tom transposed down 6 semitones. Only the picture is mirrored.
